entries.title: ULTRAKILL
entries.definitive_edition: ULTRAKILL on Windows PC, with a final-edition caveat until 1.0 leaves Early Access

emulation.notes: Use the native PC build; no emulation is needed.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PC presentation, dependent on current Early Access build.

primary.version: Current Steam Early Access PC release
primary.why: ULTRAKILL is sourced as a Windows PC Early Access release; the current PC build is the only documented shipped platform route and has the highest available fidelity/control/capture flexibility.
primary.how_to_play: Buy ULTRAKILL on Steam for Windows PC and play the current Early Access build; if you want the finished final campaign, wait for the 1.0 release.

all_releases.fidelity: Native Windows PC Early Access release.
all_releases.reason: primary: only sourced shipped platform route and best current fidelity/capture path.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: The current PC version is the only and best playable route, but the game is Early Access, so the archive route is not the finished 1.0 campaign yet.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster is documented; the major caveat is Early Access incompleteness rather than platform content differences.
